pages.text: The elite marksman variant of the FK15. Spiral-rifled barrel reduces dispersion by $(a)65%$().$(br2)$(c)Requires Create Crafters.$()
$(bold)Rifling Lathe$()$(br2)Bored on Create mechanical drill bench:$(br)• Drill + Rifle Barrel + Precision Mechanism.$(br2)Produces the spiral-cut Rifled Barrel required for master craftsmanship.
$(bold)Crafter Grid (3x3)$()$(br2)• Top: Band, Band, Barrel$(br)• Mid: Lock, Stock, Screws$(br)• Bot: Ramrod, Steel, Precision Mechanism$(br2)Assembles the prestigious FK15-R Jaeger.
$(bold)Ballistics Doctrine$()$(br2)The FK15-R excels at long-range sniper engagements.$(br2)Pairs excellently with Consecrated Silver Cartridges for hunting fiends at extreme distances.
